svg.title: AIcoach result, Skeleton Hero (round 3, 04)

text.tspan: AI
coach
Your hips are moving toward the
ball through impact. That’s early
extension, and I’m sure of it.
It may feel like you stay down, but at impact
your hips have moved toward the ball.
Feel cue · check it in the impact frame
You set up well. On the way down your hips drift toward
the ball, so your arms get crowded and your chest stands
up to make room. The likely reason: your lead hip isn’t
turning enough.

text.tspan: Set up with your backside touching a wall
(or golf bag). Make slow half swings and
keep your trail glute on the wall through
impact.

svg.text: Works on: hips toward the ball

text.tspan: Sit with both knees bent to 90°. Rotate
slowly from one side to the other, chest tall.
Generic guidance, not medical advice — see a
physiotherapist if you feel pain.

text.tspan: Why does it feel like I’m staying down
when I’m not?
The move happens below your eye line, so you don’t see it.
In your clip the hips moved 7%[3] of your body height toward the
ball. In the impact frame[2] you can see the gap to the dashed
address line. The wall drill turns that into a feel: if your
trail glute leaves the wall before impact, that’s the same move.

svg.text: Based on: [3] hip movement · [2] impact frame · drill: wall drill
How do I know the drill is working?
